*
 The Police-Inspector of Basavanagudi south Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused No.1 to 3 for the offences punishable U/s.498A,323, 506 r/w/s 34 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of D.B.Dasappa.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused No.1 married CW-3 on 20-06- 1999.

At the time of marriage, the accused No.1 and 3 along with deceased accused No.2 have demanded and taken Rs.45,000/-
cash and two gold rings weighing 15 grams, gold mangalya chain,
gold ear rings and 5 gold rings as dowry.

Further, the accused No.1 and 3 alongwith deceased accused No.2 with common intention  3  C.C.No.7552/2015 after the marriage have subjected CW-1 to mental and physical cruelty by demanding her to bring one gold Long chain and two gold bangles from her parents house, accordingly, CW-1 gave the same but, the accused have continued cruelty both physically and mentally, assaulted her, abused her in filthy language and criminally intimidated to do away with her life and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty in demand of more dowry.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.143/2014 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.

After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I.
Kempegowda nagar P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused No.1 to 3 for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.
The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused No.1 to 3 as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
During the trial of the case, accused No.2 reported as dead hence, case against accused No.2 stood abated.

4. Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused after hearing them and the prosecution  4  C.C.No.7552/2015 and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused No.1 and 3 in the language known to them, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused No.1 and 3 was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. During the pendency of the case, CW-1/complainant was reported as dead.
In support of the case of prosecution, in spite of repeated issuance of summons and warrants the jurisdictional police failed to secure the presence of Cws.-2, 4 to 16.
Hence, the prayer of Sr.APP was rejected and Cws.-2, 4 to 16 were dropped.

As none of the witnesses are examined by the prosecution and no evidence against the accused No.1 and 3, the recording of D B Dasappa vs H L Nagaraj on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183809009/

sentences.text: 3 Statement of Accused as required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C., is dispensed with.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened her and thereby accused have committed  5  C.C.No.7552/2015  the offences punishable U/s.498A,323, 506 r/w/s 34 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.?
 2) what order?
 8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:-
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- The witnesses cited in the charge sheet did not appeared and lead their evidence and there are no materials against accused No.1 and 3 as Cws.-2, 4 to 16 were not secured by the prosecution, they were dropped. This court issued summons, warrant and proclamation to Cws.-2, 4 to 16.
But the concerned police could not secure the presence of the witnesses in-spite of issuance of several times process by this court.
Moreover in this case complainant is reported as dead.
The Cws.-2, 4 to 16 may not be secured in near future days.

Hence, prayer of Sr.APP to reissue witness summons to Cw's was rejected and Cws.-2, 4 to 16 were dropped and prosecution D B Dasappa vs H L Nagaraj on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183809009/

sentences.text: 4 side evidence is taken as Nil.
Since there was no incriminating evidence against the accused, the statement of accused  6  C.C.No.7552/2015 U/s.313 of Cr.P.C. was dispensed with.

In the absence of evidence of Cws.-2, 4 to 16, there are no material to show that the accused No.1 and 3 have committed the offences punishable u/s.498A,323, 506 r/w/s 34 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Hence, I hold that the prosecution has utterly failed to prove the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

10. POINT No.2:- For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1 and 3 are acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A,323, 506 r/w/s 34 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 and 3 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
